data_issues: stim_class labels are inconsistent with movie_time_s and classes.json: every labeled trial (fit and holdout) has stim_class = (movie_time_s - 16 - 2) mod 10, i.e. labels are cyclically shifted by 2 classes (e.g. movie time 18 s labeled class 0, 16 s labeled 8). Neural continuity across adjacent segments (end of one segment matching start of the next) confirms movie_time_s is correct and stim_class is mislabeled. I relabeled as movie_time_s - 16 before training.
